Thanks for this amazing app. I’ve been searching for something like this for a long time. Quranify made it so easy to listen to the Quran that I no longer need Spotify it’s simply a much better experience.
This app is truly one of a kind. I’ve never seen anything like it for Islam and the Qur’an. I absolutely love it and would highly recommend it to every Muslim brother and sister ✨💖
I really love this app. The design feels very clean and minimal everything is easy to use and beautifully laid out. The “Bismillah” touch at the beginning adds such a nice spiritual feeling.
Assalam alaikum. This app is truly amazing it has all of my favorite reciters and really helps me feel closer to Allah. MashAllah, may Allah reward you for this.

Beautiful design, a huge selection of reciters, and all surahs available without ads. I also love the customizable background sounds it makes the listening experience even more personal. I highly recommend this app! ❤️

The sleep timer is an absolutely incredible. I’ve gotten my daughter used to falling asleep while listening to the Qur’an, and we often go to bed together with it playing. It’s so convenient to just fall asleep peacefully without worrying about turning it off later.
Great app. I love that I can listen both online and offline, it’s very convenient 👍🏻

An excellent app exactly what I’ve been looking for without even realizing it existed. I was genuinely surprised to find reciters here that I’ve never seen in other apps, and it’s great to see the collection growing all the time.

Beautiful app I really enjoy using it. It’s intuitive, easy to navigate, and has a wide selection of reciters with full surahs available. I’ve already shared it in our family group, and now almost everyone is using it. Highly recommended.

Wallahi, may Allah bless everyone who created this beautiful app. As I’m working toward becoming a Hafiz, it has truly increased my love for listening to different Qaris. It’s calming, motivating, and every recitation touches the heart. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to strengthen their connection with the Qur’an you’ll truly feel the difference. 🤲🏼✨
Each surah is synchronized with the reciter and automatically follows along

Replace music with the words of Allah
Join over 2 million people like you
Enhance your Quran listening and enjoy unlimited Audio Stories with Premium

Every subscription helps us keep Quranify ad-free, add more reciters, and build a best app for Muslims around the world. You can help others replace music and inshaAllah you’ll earn continuous reward (sadaqah jariyah).
I subscribed mainly to support the mission behind Quranify. It’s rare to find an Islamic app this beautiful, ad-free, and focused purely on helping Muslims reconnect with the Quran.

My dear Muslim brothers and sisters, think about your Hereafter. Many of us spend money on entertainment and distractions, but supporting something that keeps you connected to the Quran is far more valuable.

I used to listen to music every day while driving. Since subscribing to Quranify, I’ve replaced that habit with Quran. The offline downloads and background sounds make it so easy to listen everywhere.
Wallahi this app helped me reduce music more than anything else. Having exclusive reciters and offline listening makes it easier to keep Quran playing throughout the day.
I recently converted to Islam, and the Quran lyrics and tafsir feature have helped me understand the Quran so much better. And it has truly made my journey easier and more peaceful.

By subscribing to Quranify, I’m not only investing in myself and my relationship with the Quran, but also helping spread Allah’s words to more people. InshaAllah, every person who benefits can become a source of continuous reward for me.
